elements.content:
Column chart; x-axis: Country / Group; y-axis: GERD as a percentage of GDP (%) from 0.0 to 4.5 in intervals of 0.5; Legend: None;
- Australia: 1.9
- China: 2.1

- Thailand: 0.6

Source: UIS.
Comparisons: Republic of Korea has the highest GERD at 4.2% of GDP, followed by Switzeland at 3.4%; Indonesia and the Philippines have the lowest at 0.1% each; Viet Nam's expenditure of 0.4% equals the Lower middle income countries average (0.4%) and is below the Middle income countries average (1.1%).
